forum.title: Pinout details for all variants of SR5E1E7 MCU
forum.best_answer_content:
@sanket471

Exactly there the pinout can also be found. But let's go through it step by step:

1. Open the [product website](https://www.st.com/en/automotive-microcontrollers/sr5e1e7.html), go to the [Documentation tab](https://www.st.com/en/automotive-microcontrollers/sr5e1e7.html#documentation)

2. Search for the term "definition" on this website

3. Find [TN1404](https://www.st.com/resource/en/technical_note/tn1404-sr5e1e3-sr5e1e5-sr5e1e7-io-definition-signal-description-and-input-multiplexing-tables-and-device-identification-registers-stmicroelectronics.pdf) and open it with a PDF viewer that can handle attachments

4. Open the Attachments tab of the PDF viewer and find "SR5E1x-IO\_Definition\_V4.xlsx"

I hope I was able to help a little with finding the information?

Regards

/Peter

scraped_replies.html: Unfortunately, this is one of the pitfalls you can fall into if you don't use a PDF viewer that supports attachments, but rather just the one that comes with the browser. However, you can easily switch the PDF engine to an external viewer in Edge as well.
